title: Principled review state and adaptive Theseus loop

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User priority preserving review history while making current state principled and queryable.
Approved decision to expose one adaptive loop skill with automatic recommendation and override.

verification: node --test focused dev-review protocol, store, inbox, CLI, retention, and skill contract suites
npx playwright test focused review-shell, reader capture, counter, lifecycle, and visual checkpoint cohorts
npm run typecheck and npm run build
skill quick validation and isolated forward tests
allowedWork: Dev-review protocols, schemas, append-only storage, migration projections, services, dev-only HTTP and typed client boundaries, review shell, repository CLI, tests, and production-exclusion checks.
Personal Codex skills kp-review-logs and theseus-loop, compatibility treatment for theseus-long-loop, deterministic skill validation, and bounded forward tests.
Risk-tiered verification manifests, focused test selection, persistent local visual harnesses, deterministic contact sheets, Theseus graph evidence, and exact per-slice commits.
disallowedWork: Do not delete, rewrite, upload, or silently compact source review events; derived indexes and archives must remain reproducible from append-only history.
Do not infer that a note is obsolete from age alone, auto-create Theseus work from comments, or mutate live note status or consumer cursors during dry-run validation.
Do not include review tooling in production bundles or servers, generalize equation motifs, resume missing-middle work, or broaden into public multi-user review infrastructure.
Do not silently escalate an approved iteration mode into long mode; stop and request approval when the selected envelope is exceeded.
goal: Preserve append-only visual review history while making current state unambiguous through explicit rounds, statuses, bounded queries, and consumer cursors; deliver a validated kp-review-logs skill; automate risk-tiered verification and visual checkpoints; and expose one adaptive theseus-loop skill that recommends iteration or long mode with user override.
commitCadence: Commit after each independently verified slice; combine only inseparable skill metadata and validation changes.
stopConditions: Stop immediately if any existing review note, ordering, status, route evidence, or append-only event is lost or rewritten.
Stop if review endpoints, strings, assets, or UI enter production output or an uninjected server.
Stop if bounded current-state queries cannot distinguish historical and active rounds without loading the full log into LLM context.
Stop if adaptive mode selection cannot explain its recommendation, honor an explicit override, or detect when iteration scope must escalate.
Stop after s27 for explicit human approval before resuming generated-equation generalization.

slices.title: Modernize-the-inbox-run-boundary
slices.summary: Created the approved current-schema run boundary, preserved and deferred the legacy contract, completed the target done contract, repaired six historical source moves, and achieved a clean quick autonomy gate.

slices.title: Define-review-round-acceptance
slices.summary: Added executable acceptance laws for explicit rounds, bounded current queries, stable cursors, replay-only legacy migration, non-destructive history, and separate current-new versus lifetime counts.

slices.title: Add-versioned-review-round-protocol
slices.summary: Introduced kp.dev-review.v2 with strict round lifecycle, baseline provenance, round-scoped notes and cursors, current-round inbox state, public exports, and full v1 compatibility.

slices.title: Project-v1-history-into-synthetic-rounds
slices.summary: Added deterministic replay-only v1 migration: sessions become synthetic rounds, prior rounds close, the latest remains current, round-scoped cursors retain meaning, and original note/source data remains byte-stable.

slices.title: Add-current-round-projection-and-service
slices.summary: Delivered the mixed-version append-only store and round inbox service with explicit lifecycle, current-round authority, round-scoped cursors, serialized concurrent notes, fail-closed ordering, and restart-stable projection.

slices.title: Define-bounded-current-state-queries
slices.summary: Bounded query defaults to the current round, makes history explicit, composes status, route, sequence, and round-scoped unread filters, paginates stably, and keeps full captures opt-in.

slices.title: Add-derived-index-and-checkpoint-policy
slices.summary: Added a revision-keyed in-memory projection cache and atomic durable derived index with source digest, validated counts, stale/corrupt fallback, and proof that source history is untouched.

slices.title: Expose-typed-dev-only-review-operations
slices.summary: Exposed strict v2 query, round, note, status, and cursor operations through a typed client and capability-gated HTTP adapter; dev configuration shares one store with legacy compatibility and production closure remains clean.

slices.title: Show-current-round-state-in-the-review-shell
slices.summary: The canonical shell now presents its active imported or explicit round and submits immutable captures into that round via v2; empty histories bootstrap a baseline-stamped current round without changing the visual motif.

slices.title: Replace-lifetime-counter-with-current-unread-semantics
slices.summary: The inbox badge now reports current-round notes beyond the codex.main cursor, not lifetime sequence; it initializes from bounded query state, increments after a confirmed save, and exposes explicit accessible semantics.

slices.title: Add-explicit-note-lifecycle-controls
slices.summary: Review lifecycle is now an enforced domain contract: explicit legal transitions, no silent no-ops or stage skips, and required reasons for dismissing or reopening terminal notes; the capture shell remains uncluttered.

slices.title: Add-bounded-review-log-query-CLI
slices.summary: Added npm run review:logs: bounded current-round JSON by default, explicit history or all scopes, status/route/unread filters, stable continuation, full-capture opt-in, and tests proving the query path does not mutate source events.

slices.title: Add-status-and-consumer-cursor-CLI
slices.summary: The review CLI now supports explicit status and consumer-cursor mutations plus validated --dry-run previews; tests prove previews append nothing and actual commands replay to the intended projected state.
